Owner decisions 2026-10-30 (interactive, spec drafting): a running node hides its tokens line until the first usage event; on the Running entry the bar always stays and the stall cue outlasts the role or pipeline cell only (edit the doc sentence that says the entry drops heard before the bar); the fit-test fix stays in S146 (v1.0) and lands before S101; the detail wrap applies to live run rows only. Owner decisions 2026-10-30 (interactive, review round 1): the run-id fit is decided once per section, so if any run row in a section would drop its id, every run row in that section drops it; the detail wrap between cells applies to every row with a live run (Running and engine Needs rows), not decision, Ready or Recent rows.
